rq_text: On what basis should identifiers be assigned to post-branch entities?
At what point should the inheritance rules for responsibilities, rights, and consent diverge?
How should mismatches between the psychological continuity criterion and the legal individual criterion be handled?
How should technical evaluation (performance) be connected to personhood evaluation (attribution)?
If memory editing or resynchronization occurs between branched entities, what criteria should trigger reorganization of the legal entity ID?
When consent is withdrawn, how should revocation of permissions across multiple branched entities be implemented and audited technically?
Under which legal concept should the sensitivity of neural data be handled (personal data, biometric data, or personhood-related data)?
How should neurorights be mapped onto technical audit items?
How should the minimum common operating model across jurisdictions (EU/US/JP, etc.) be defined?
How should stop conditions and update conditions be governed as technology evolves?
